decisions.name: 阿翔
decisions.reason: Full 1920x2560 source pixels were inspected. The target appears in a black/red shirt and backward cap with head tilted downward; eyes are nearly shut/obscured by brow and cap shadow. Another large person in pink is present. Although a manual crop could remove the second person, the target's downcast eyes and oblique angle make a clear eye-first five-stage reveal unsuitable. Seek an unobstructed forward-facing solo portrait; do not reuse this original for a game crop.
decisions.caption: 浩角翔起的阿翔

notes: This is a source-only visual rejection, not a live release or a person identity certification.
The 10-person diagnostic produced zero playable crops. The other nine subjects had no source-only pixel assets to visually approve.
No existing approved/rejected person reviews were reopened.
